messages:
jordan (AE): Heads up — enterprise prospect called; procurement wants a concise package: DFD, subprocessors with EU-only flags, and explicit statement re: prompt retention. They asked for a declarative line: 'Do you store raw prompts?' Can we answer today?

li (SE): Quick status: Hosted customers default to managed key + ephemeral storage. We can state we do not persist raw prompts longer than 30 days by default for observability logs, but we can shorten or disable retention. For Dedicated/Private customers, they control storage and KMS.

maria (InfoSec): I'll draft the DFD and a short risk note. Key points: encrypted transit, per-tenant isolation logical layer, KV cache never persisted to long-term storage, backups are EU-only if requested. Also mention subprocessors that touch logs: FastLog, Sentry, CloudStorageEdge.

sam (Legal): Procurement will want subprocessors CSV + DPA. Also confirm we will not use customer content for model training. Add SCCs and DPA options if they require EU data residency legal guarantees.

vendor-risk-bot: Internal note — canonical subprocessor list: AWS-eu-west-1 (compute), CloudStorageEdge (EU backup), Datadog (EU metrics), FastLog (logging, EU optional), Sentry (error monitoring). Full list at /internal/vendor_register/subprocessors-current.csv

li (SE): Draft DFD (compact):
```
Client -> TLS -> API Gateway (eu-west-1)
  -> Router -> Inference Pool (gpus eu-west-1)
    -> Redis (volatile cache eu-west-1)
    -> Metrics -> Datadog (eu-region)
    -> Logs -> FastLog (EU option) -> Encrypted backups CloudStorageEdge
Notes: Logs may include prompt/response shards unless disabled. No training use of customer data.```

jordan (AE): Procurement also asked: 'If eu capacity is saturated, will data be processed outside EU without notice?' Need an explicit policy.

maria (InfoSec): Policy: we default to EU routing and will not route outside EU for production traffic without contractual consent. Emergency failover procedures exist and will be documented; cross-region processing events are logged and require manual approval.

sam (Legal): I'll prepare language for the DPA and mark the clauses for subprocessors and cross-border transfers.

li (SE): Deliverables: 1-pager DFD + 3 bullet PII-hotspots today; subprocessor table tomorrow morning; CAIQ updates within 72 hours.

jordan (AE): Thanks team. I'll tell procurement we'll have the DFD + quick answers today and fuller package tomorrow.

vendor-risk-bot: Reminder: attach redacted subprocessor CSV for external sharing: /internal/vendor_register/subprocessors-redacted.csv (request access).
